purpose: Diagnostic-correctness fix: the enabled-vGIC hv_exc_irq EOI note reads the architectural ELR_EL2 (hv_get_elr()) instead of the never-initialized ctx->elr. Evidence-accuracy only; NOT a watchdog fix.

untouched: generic main build / S194 current artifact

the_fix.reason: The ENABLE_VGIC_MODULE hv_exc_irq path never calls hv_get_context(); the assembly entry (_exc_entry) saves only x0-x29, so exc_info.elr/spsr/esr are populated solely by hv_get_context() in C, which only the sync/abort paths call. ctx->elr in this IRQ branch is therefore uninitialized stack. hv_get_elr() reads ELR_EL2 architecturally. Confirmed by S163 README review note (2026-09-10 01:10).
the_fix.preserves: IRQ spacing, mask, queue, generation and delivery semantics; changes only the recorded EOI PC diagnostic.

extraction_note: hv_bridge_nvme_irq and nwoas_nvme_note_eoi are byte-identical between the S208 candidate and the recorded S163 snapshot; the fix is entirely at the hv_exc_irq call site.
